notice.readOnly: Read-only: changes from the dashboard are switched off on this Mewvo instance. Use the bot's commands.

viewOnly.actions: View only: you need Administrator in this server to take enforcement actions here.
viewOnly.cases: View only: you need Administrator in this server to change cases here.
viewOnly.appeals: View only: you need Administrator in this server to decide appeals here.
viewOnly.orders: View only: you need Administrator in this server to start or end orders here.

confirm.nothingYet: Nothing has changed yet. This confirmation works once and expires in 5 minutes.
confirm.once: This confirmation works once and expires in 5 minutes.
confirm.heading: Confirm: {action}
confirm.title: Confirm {action}
confirm.blocked: You are blocked by the safety limit (too many bans or kicks in 10 minutes) until {date}; this will be refused.

list.title: Members
list.help: open a member to change their roles or take an action.
list.empty: No members to show yet. The list fills once the bot has loaded this server.
list.stillLoading: Showing {cached} of {total} members: the member list is still loading. Reload in a minute.
list.unavailable: The member list is not available right now (the bot cannot see this server).

bulk.summaryHint: · tick members below, or use everyone matching the filters
bulk.customHint: Only used with "Custom…". Each member gets the same DM and case as one-by-one.
bulk.note: Nothing happens yet: the next page shows exactly who will be changed and who is skipped, and why. At most {max} members; kicks and bans only as many as the safety limit (too many bans or kicks in 10 minutes) still allows.
bulk.check: Check the list. Nothing has been changed yet.

guard.one: The safety limit (too many bans or kicks in 10 minutes) allows {count} more ban/kick in this 10-minute window; members beyond that are skipped.
guard.other: The safety limit (too many bans or kicks in 10 minutes) allows {count} more bans/kicks in this 10-minute window; members beyond that are skipped.

bulk.nobody: Nobody: every selected member is skipped.
bulk.runs: Runs one member at a time (Discord rate limits); you can leave the page and come back to the progress.
bulk.sameDm: Every member gets the same DM and case as a single action.
bulk.title: Bulk: {what}

job.working: Working… {done} of {total} done. This page updates itself.

bans.title: Banned
bans.empty: Nobody is banned in this server.
bans.help: Unban opens the member page: you see the effect, then confirm. The member gets a DM with an invite back.
bans.truncated: Showing the first {count} bans: Discord's ban list is longer than that. Open a member by user ID to see someone who is not listed.

profile.yesUnknown: yes, joined at an unknown time

edit.needsAdminEditing: Changing roles needs Administrator and editing turned on.
edit.giveRoleHint: Only roles below your highest role and Mewvo's; staff roles only for the server owner or bot owners.
edit.timedHint: Timed roles are taken off automatically, and given back if they rejoin before the end.
edit.noOtherRole: There is no other role you can give.
edit.timeoutHint: Discord's own timeout (max 28 days): they can read but not write or talk. For longer, use Mute.
edit.unverifyReason: Reason (optional, Discord audit log and verification log)
edit.unverifyConfirm: Remove verification from {name}? They lose @{role} and must verify again.

notes.empty: No staff notes yet. Add one below; only staff can see them.
notes.new: New note (only staff can see it)

keepApart.title: Keep apart
keepApart.heading: Keep apart ({count})
keepApart.help: Keep two members apart: they may not mention or reply to each other; breaking messages are deleted and logged. Both members are DMed when an order starts and ends.

precedent.question: How was this reason handled before?
precedent.none: No earlier cases with this reason to compare.

action.name: Name (optional)
action.evidenceHint: Up to {max} links, one per line. Their text is saved now. Images can be uploaded on the case page afterwards.

timeline.error: The timeline could not be loaded (database). Reload the page to try again.
timeline.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Joins and leaves are kept 90 days.
timeline.note: Newest first. Joins and leaves are kept 90 days.

member.moderatorCan: Moderator: you can {actions} here. Ban, unban, roles, nickname and notes need Administrator.
member.blocked: You are blocked by the safety limit (too many bans or kicks in 10 minutes) until {date}; actions will be refused.
member.sameActions: Same actions, DMs, ladder and checks as /enforcements. Each one shows a confirmation first.
member.precedent: What staff usually gave for this reason

watch.title: Watchlist ({count})
watch.help: Staff only; the member is never told. Their joins, new cases and automod hits are posted in the mod log (at most once a minute). Add members with {command}.

findMember.tooShort: Type at least 2 letters of the name.
findMember.discordFailed: Discord did not answer the search, so only members Mewvo already knows are listed.
findMember.bansFailed: The ban list could not be loaded, so banned users are not listed.

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.help: Takes all their roles away (they are saved) and hides every channel from them. They stay in the server and get a DM with the reason and your support server invite. Head admins are pinged in the alerts channel.
quarantine.reasonHint: Required. Shown in their DM, the alert and the mod log.
quarantine.confirm: Quarantine {name}? They lose every role and see no channel until released.
quarantine.releaseConfirm: Release {name}? Their saved roles come back.
quarantine.notSet: Quarantine needs a quarantine role that Mewvo can give.
quarantine.setLink: Set it on Enforcement & appeals → Roles.
quarantine.unreadable: Whether this member is quarantined could not be read right now (database not responding).
quarantine.notDecider: Only the server owner and the decider roles (Enforcement & appeals → Roles) can decide what happens next.
quarantine.kickConfirm: Kick {name}? They get a DM first and a one-time invite to come back.
quarantine.banConfirm: Ban {name}? They get a DM first.
